headline: Meta paper reports agentic experiment controls caught a false negative in a 37-day retrieval campaign
summary: Meta authors describe EvoPilot, a human-gated agent workflow for experiments spanning asynchronous training, publishing, serving and evaluation systems. In one 37-day Video Deep Dive campaign, an initial autoresearch comparison appeared to show a 22-point offline hit-rate decline, but review found the control and treatment used different effective output depths. A matched comparison later reported a 3.20-point offline gain for enabling the interaction head, and a separate seven-day randomized online test reported a 0.66% relative increase in the product’s VDD slice of Good Search Result Rate for Retention. The operational analysis includes nine of twenty rounds with complete records; results are reported by the system’s authors and do not establish cross-organization performance.
